card.name: Slot after verbs of undergoing change
card.fires_on: The word right after a verb or phrase meaning to go through or endure something (undergone a, withstood, experiencing, suffering from, survived past). It marks the spot where a noun for a hardship or change is expected.

modes.label: After undergo/endure verbs
modes.description: A word that follows a verb of going through something and leads into a change or hardship.

modes.label: Facing trouble or decline
modes.description: A word after a phrase about problems, collapse or difficulty that sets up a named hardship.
modes.example: ecosystems that are on the<< brink>> of collapse.

card.writes: It suppresses the verbs undergo and experience, so the model avoids repeating those verbs where one has just been used or implied.
card.plain: It fires on the word after a phrase like 'has been through' or 'is suffering from', where the text names a hardship or change.
